items.name: theme
items.title: AiMY theme
items.description: Install first. Adds the AiMY tokens (colour, type, spacing, radius, shadow, motion, layers), Poppins and JetBrains Mono, the transitions.dev snippets and base styles, and maps them to Tailwind v4 so classes read in AiMY's words (bg-card, text-ink, text-meta). Switches off Tailwind's own palette and type scale, so off-system values fail to build. Dark is the default; light is data-theme="light". Needs the @flairstech-aimy npm scope in .npmrc.

items.name: aliases
items.title: Old token names
items.description: Optional, for Sales and Knowledge only: maps old names (--qa-accent, --hairline, --ai-text, --err-line, --teal-label) to the library's, so a product can adopt components without renaming. A new product never needs it.

items.name: init
items.title: Init
items.description: Starts AiMY UI in an existing React app in one command: the theme and fonts, cn, the theme toggle, toast with undo, and the rules for AI agents (AGENTS.md, the aimy-ui Claude skill, and the build, review and upgrade skills), so the first screen an agent builds already follows AiMY's doctrine.

items.name: utils
items.title: cn() class helper
items.description: Joins class names and resolves Tailwind conflicts so a className passed to any AiMY component overrides its defaults. Every AiMY component depends on it.

items.name: theme-constants
items.title: Theme constants
items.description: THEME_KEY (aimy-ds-theme) and themeScript, the pre-paint script, in a plain module so a Next.js server component can render it in <head>.

items.name: use-theme
items.title: useTheme
items.description: Reads and sets the AiMY theme (dark or light) on <html data-theme>, saved under the localStorage key aimy-ds-theme that every AiMY product uses. Pauses colour transitions for the swap. Also exports themeScript for the pre-paint script.

items.name: theme-script
items.title: ThemeScript
items.description: Put inside <head>. Applies the saved theme before first paint so a light-theme user never sees a dark flash.

items.name: theme-toggle
items.title: ThemeToggle
items.description: The one-click light/dark switch from the AiMY topnav. Sun and moon cross-fade with the transitions.dev icon swap. Has an accessible name that says which theme it switches to.

items.name: icon
items.title: Icon
items.description: Renders a lucide-react glyph at an AiMY size (xs 12, sm 14, md 16, lg 20, xl 24), stroke 2, hidden from screen readers unless given a label. Use it for every icon; never draw icon paths by hand.

items.name: aimy-mark
items.title: AimyMark
items.description: The AiMY logo: the mark alone (variant icon) or with the wordmark (variant lockup), path data verbatim from the canonical logo. Set --aimy-mark: currentColor on a brand-filled control to keep the mark legible.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: The AiMY button, a pill as both products draw it. Variants: brand (the one filled primary per surface, white words, the AiMY mark turns white), ghost (the quiet control: an edge, no fill; the default), accent (an action AiMY will take), ok, warn, err (tinted ground, readable ink), text (a quiet verb in the accent ink). Sizes sm 28, md 32, lg 40. loading shows a spinner and blocks clicks. Label every button with a verb; never Open or Learn more when the action has a name. Use asChild to style a router link.

items.name: icon-button
items.title: IconButton
items.description: A square control for an icon alone, with a required label that becomes its accessible name and tooltip. default sits on the raised surface with an edge; toolbar has no box until hovered and shows its on state (aria-pressed) in the accent. Sizes sm 28, md 32, lg 36.

items.name: link
items.title: Link
items.description: Coloured words for going somewhere: brand ink, underline on hover, or always underlined inside a sentence (variant inline). A link has neither fill nor edge. For an action, use Button variant text instead. asChild wraps a router link.

items.name: tag
items.title: Tag
items.description: A label for a state: a soft ground of the hue and the word in the readable ink, no edge (a label has a fill, a control has an edge). Tones neutral, ok, warn, err, info, ai, accent. Write the name of the state in sentence case, two words both capitalised: Meeting Set. Never colour alone.

items.name: chip
items.title: Chip
items.description: A toggle for filtering, with an edge because you can press it. selected takes the accent; unselected words stay fully readable. onRemove adds a remove control with its own name. Reports state with aria-pressed.

items.name: count-badge
items.title: CountBadge
items.description: An unread count pinned to the top right of a control (put it in a relative parent). White on #d92d20 so it reads in both themes. label says what is counted, for screen readers. Over max shows as 99+.

items.name: status
items.title: StatusPill and StatusDot
items.description: Presence in words with a coloured dot: online, busy, away, offline. The dot never appears without the word in a product surface, and it never pulses.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Key caps for a keyboard shortcut: <Kbd keys={["Ctrl", "K"]} />.

items.name: divider
items.title: Divider
items.description: A 1px rule in the edge colour, horizontal or vertical. With children it becomes a labelled section marker between two rules.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar, AimyAvatar, AvatarGroup
items.description: A person as their photo (with the face ring) or initials on the avatar gradient; AiMY as its mark on the AiMY tile, so AiMY is never shown with a person's face. Sizes xs 24, sm 28, md 32, lg 44. AvatarGroup overlaps faces and shows +N past max.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Wraps a form control with its label above and help or an error below, and wires them up: the control gets the id, aria-describedby and aria-invalid. A new error makes the control shake once (transitions.dev 12); the message stays until fixed. Never use a placeholder as a label.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A one-line text field. variant box (card ground, edge, 36px; the default) or line (an underline, for forms inside dialogs and AiMY panels). 16px text, brand focus. Put it in a Field.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Several lines that grow with the text up to 12 lines, then scroll. No resize handle. variant box or line. Put it in a Field.

items.name: search-field
items.title: SearchField
items.description: Find-as-you-type with a search icon, a clear button that appears only when there is text, and Escape to clear. variant box or line. label names the field for screen readers and is the default placeholder.

items.name: select
items.title: Select and SelectItem
items.description: The only select control; never a native <select>. A pill with an inset ring that opens a raised panel; the chosen option is in the AI ink with a dot. Full keyboard model and typeahead. Opens and closes with transitions.dev menu dropdown (05). Use label when it is not inside a Field.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A 17px box: brand fill and a white tick when on, a dash for some (checked="indeterminate"). The tick draws in (transitions.dev 25). label puts clickable words beside it.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: An on/off switch, 36 by 20: the brand when on. The thumb travels with a small bounce (transitions.dev 27). A disabled switch keeps its position readable and shows lockedReason as a tooltip. label puts words beside it.

items.name: segmented
items.title: Segmented
items.description: Two to five mutually exclusive options in a pill, as a radiogroup: arrow keys move and choose. The highlight slides between options (transitions.dev 16). label names the group.

items.name: password-field
items.title: PasswordField
items.description: A secret (API key, token, password), masked, in the mono face, with a show/hide control inside the field that names what it will do. variant box or line. Put it in a Field.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: CopyButton
items.description: Copies a value and says so in words: Copy, then Copied for 1.4s (or Press Ctrl+C if the browser refuses), announced to screen readers. The icon swaps copy to check.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: The record card both products draw: an article with CardHead (a state Tag and CardType), CardTitle (a real button or link whose hit area covers the card), CardSummary, CardFacts, CardBody and CardFoot (stay clickable on their own). status ok, warn or err tints the edge; never a left stripe.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs, TabsList, Tab, TabPanel
items.description: A real tablist with arrow keys. size page (18px, counts, an ink bar: Sales view switcher) or section (14px, a hairline under the strip, a brand underline: Knowledge settings). The bar slides with transitions.dev tabs sliding (16). Use for views of one thing; not for moving between pages.

items.name: disclosure
items.title: Disclosure
items.description: Show or hide one section in place: a header with an optional count and a chevron, the body sliding open with transitions.dev accordion (21). For bounded sections such as a call transcript; not for hiding open-ended data.

items.name: pager
items.title: Pager
items.description: Paging in words: 1–15 of 134 contacts, page 1 of 9, with Back and Next text actions that say how many. One page reads: 134 contacts, all shown.

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: A menu of actions or choices from a control: MenuItem (acts and closes; danger for destructive), MenuRadioGroup and MenuRadioItem (one answer), MenuCheckboxItem (several answers; stays open), MenuLabel, MenuSeparator, MenuSearch (filters long lists). Items take a description line and a leading icon or avatar. Full keyboard model. Opens with transitions.dev menu dropdown (05).

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip and InfoTip
items.description: A short hint on hover or keyboard focus, after 80ms (transitions.dev tooltip, 17). Nothing inside can be clicked; use Popover for that. InfoTip is the small question-mark button that explains a label.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A small panel tied to a control, for a few fields or an explanation with a button. Moves focus inside; Escape or an outside click closes and returns focus. Opens with transitions.dev menu dropdown (05).

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A month grid, single day or range, weeks from Monday: today outlined, the choice in the accent, a range on an accent wash. Arrow keys, Home, End, Page Up and Down. disableFuture for filters on past activity.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: DatePicker
items.description: A date or range filter: a pill like Select that opens quick choices and the Calendar. A quick choice or the second day of a range closes it.

items.name: toast
items.title: toast() and Toaster
items.description: The confirmation every action ends with: act at once, then toast what happened with Undo. toast(title, { sub, onUndo }). One at a time; 6s with Undo, 4s without; waits while hovered or focused; announced politely. Render <Toaster /> once at the root (offset lifts it above a composer bar). Rises and leaves with transitions.dev toast (22).

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog and TypeToConfirm
items.description: Dialog: for ordered forms and changes with consequences, never to confirm what Undo can take back. Title, optional description, a scrolling body and an end-aligned footer; focus trapped, Escape closes, focus returns (transitions.dev modal, 06). TypeToConfirm: the last rung for destructive or governed changes: the named action stays disabled until the word or number is typed.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A panel that slides in from the side over the page, with a scrim: the rail as a drawer below the rail rung, settings and connection sheets. Title, scrolling body, Escape or the scrim closes, focus returns. Slides with transitions.dev panel reveal (07).

items.name: notice
items.title: Notice
items.description: A notice in the page: neutral, info, ok, warn or err. A tinted ground with an icon and words, an optional title and an action that resolves it (Try again, Open the new version). Never a coloured left stripe. err is announced at once.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: EmptyState and ErrorState
items.description: EmptyState: why there is nothing here and the way forward (Clear filters, New document), with an icon tile and an optional fine line; dashed or plain. ErrorState: what failed, that nothing was lost, and Try again.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton, SkeletonCard, Reveal
items.description: Placeholders shaped like what is coming, pulsing while loading; Reveal cross-fades from the skeleton to the content when loading ends (transitions.dev skeleton reveal, 14). label names what is loading for screen readers.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: How much is done or used: thin (3px) for work in progress, meter (6px) or large (8px) for usage. limit turns a meter warn from 80% and err from 95%. Always put the numbers in words beside it.

items.name: ai-types
items.title: AI data types
items.description: The shapes every AI component reads: Turn (speaker, text, status: thinking, streaming, done, stopped, failed), Person, Basis, Attachment, ReasoningStep, Rating. Map your stream (SignalR, the Vercel AI SDK) to these once.

items.name: thinking
items.title: ThinkingIndicator and ThinkMark
items.description: AiMY at work before any words: the particle think-mark (the AiMY mark scattering and gathering, ported from the products) and a line saying what it does. Pass one label or several beats to step through; the line shimmers and swaps with transitions.dev thinking states (28). Under reduced motion the mark is drawn once, at rest. Use while a turn's status is thinking; never a spinner.

items.name: streaming-text
items.title: StreamingText
items.description: Text that arrives over time: pass the text so far and streaming. Each new word resolves from a 1px blur, 60ms apart (transitions.dev streaming text, 30); text present at mount shows at once. No caret. Reduced motion shows words as they come.

items.name: message
items.title: Message
items.description: One conversation turn in Sales' shape: 28px avatar (AiMY's tile, or the person), a bubble up to 540px with the square corner on the speaker's side. status thinking shows the think-mark instead of a bubble; stopped keeps the text and says Stopped; failed says nothing was lost. `after` holds ResponseActions or follow-up Suggestions, aligned with the bubble. AiMY's turns never show a person's face.

items.name: response-actions
items.title: ResponseActions
items.description: What a person can do with one answer (Knowledge's .msg-acts): Copy, Retry, the N sources it stands on, and Useful / Not useful (mutually exclusive, toggles). Each says what happened in a toast. Always shown, in secondary ink. Needs <Toaster /> at the root.

items.name: suggestions
items.title: Suggestions
items.description: One-click questions: openers centred in an empty conversation, follow-ups under an answer. Write them as the questions a person would ask. Chips rise in 40ms apart.

items.name: reasoning
items.title: Reasoning
items.description: How AiMY got to an answer, folded under it: 'How this was answered' with steps that say what AiMY did and why (Knowledge's act-log; Sales' 'Why AiMY wrote it this way'). Opens with the accordion (21). Not a 'Thought for Ns' timer: neither product uses one.

items.name: composer
items.title: Composer
items.description: Where a person asks AiMY, as the products' voice.js arranges it. variant float (one line over the work) or canvas (several lines). Enter sends; nothing empty is sent. The mic dictates: a red waveform and clock replace the field, cancel or keep (keep puts the words in the field). onVoice turns the empty send slot into the voice button. generating rides the beam and turns send into stop. onAttach adds the clip; a file is a row inside the bar, saying not uploaded until it is. unavailable (a sentence saying what still works) keeps the bar and the text; a question sent then goes when AiMY is back. usage puts Knowledge's ring on the AiMY mark, opening the numbers on hover, focus or press.

items.name: canvas
items.title: Canvas
items.description: The AiMY canvas: glass over the page from under the topbar, with 'Based on' (what the conversation is about), a chats column that becomes a drawer below 900px, the thread (a polite live log) and the canvas Composer. Focus goes to the composer; Escape or × closes and returns focus. 400ms in, 350ms out. Keeps the backdrop-filter, as the doctrine requires. The meeting slot holds a NoteTaker with layout="canvas" in place of the thread and composer (Knowledge's meeting view).

items.name: use-voice
items.title: useDictation and useVoiceSession
items.description: The microphone, ported from the products' voice.js. useDictation: the composer's mic (waveform levels, a clock, keep puts the words in the field, nothing is sent). useVoiceSession({ ask }): a spoken conversation with phases connecting, listening, thinking, speaking, muted and error; sends once you pause, reads the answer aloud, tap to interrupt. Uses the browser's own speech recognition and synthesis; where they are missing or the mic is refused it says so in words (VOICE_SAY) and never invents a sentence.

items.name: orb
items.title: Orb
items.description: The Silk orb: hair-fine strands of light on a turning drum (ported from the products' voice.js). phase connecting, listening (your voice level swells it), thinking, speaking (breathes), muted (drains to grey), error. Fills its box; draws one still frame under reduced motion. Used by VoiceStage and NoteTaker.

items.name: voice-stage
items.title: VoiceStage
items.description: A voice conversation as a place: the page goes away, one orb stays with a line saying what it does (Listening, Thinking, Answering, You're muted, or the error in words), the session clock, and mute and end. The orb is a button only while AiMY answers (tap to interrupt). Pair with useVoiceSession. onTakeNotes adds Take meeting notes; asking replaces the state line (NoteTakerConsent).

items.name: note-taker
items.title: NoteTaker and NoteTakerConsent
items.description: AiMY takes notes in a meeting, hearing only you. fold: the Silk orb in the corner (drag it; it settles on the nearer side) with who is speaking and a count. card: Transcription and Notes tabs, End notes, and one bar that asks AiMY or adds a private note. Phases live, ended, writing (three steps tick off), ready (summary, decisions, your to-dos), short, failed (Try again; the transcript is safe). NoteTakerConsent asks on the voice stage first. layout="canvas" lays the meeting out full height in the AiMY Canvas (Knowledge's canvas view): tabs in the header, Back to the meeting, a 42rem reading column.

items.name: trust-state
items.title: TrustState
items.description: The trust condition of a source, on the source (Knowledge's statusBadge): current (No issues), outdated (Out of date), conflicting, draft, unowned, unused, superseded (also says Not in answers). Tone and words together; the title says why; a dot when a person set it by hand.

items.name: citation
items.title: Citation
items.description: A numbered marker in an answer that points at its source (Knowledge's .cite). Hover or keyboard focus opens the preview: title, trust state, the quoted passage, where it came from, and Flag (feedback per citation). Escape closes it; a tap opens it on touch. Numbers match the answer's SourceList.

items.name: source-list
items.title: SourceList
items.description: The sources an answer stands on (Knowledge's sourceRow): number, kind, title, where it came from, trust state; a row opens the document. inline in the answer, or drawer under it ('What this answer stands on', opened from ResponseActions). Wraps to two lines below 520px rather than lose the title.

items.name: trust-disclosure
items.title: TrustDisclosure
items.description: What an answer is grounded on, said under it (Knowledge's .trust-disclosure): rows in ok, warn, err or none tone, and the warm exclusion ground when nothing could answer, with DisclosureAction for the way forward. Every answer states its grounding; the exclusion case is never silent.

items.name: confidence
items.title: Confidence
items.description: How sure AiMY is about a group of facts, in words, with why (Sales' .b-conf): ok (a check), old (May be out of date, Check again), gap (Partly known), none (Not known yet, Find out more), busy (Checking again). The explanation says where the facts came from and when. Not a score: use Score for ratings.

items.name: score
items.title: Score
items.description: A rating out of 100 with a three-bar meter (Knowledge's ICP Fit badge): high from 75, medium from 50, low below. For how well something matches; for how sure AiMY is about a fact, use Confidence.

items.name: source-line
items.title: SourceLine
items.description: Where an answer's facts came from, in one plain line under it (Sales' .s-ans-cite): 'From your last 3 calls'. For numbered citations use SourceList.

items.name: work-state
items.title: WorkState
items.description: Where a surfaced item stands, required on every item (doctrine §2.3): detected (Found), recommended (Suggested), drafted (Drafted), staged (Awaiting you), completed (Done), failed (Stopped). Sales' pill; a specific label may replace the word, never the state.

items.name: entry-action
items.title: EntryAction
items.description: An action that declares how it behaves (doctrine §3); mode is required so an unclassified action does not compile. direct = primary (completes in place, offers Undo; one per surface), review = secondary (shows a proposal), investigate and prompt = tertiary text (open a conversation). aimy puts the AiMY mark on actions AiMY carries out.

items.name: suggestion
items.title: Suggestion
items.description: A change AiMY proposes, shown as a change (Knowledge's editor suggestion): old wording struck through, new wording after, Accept, Edit, Reject. Never applied silently; Edit makes the new wording editable and Accept applies what is there. pending shows the steps AiMY is on. Toasts Applied (with Undo) or Rejected.

items.name: agent-steps
items.title: AgentSteps
items.description: AiMY's work step by step while it runs (Sales' curation trace): what it is doing with a running clock, a line saying the person can leave, steps that appear as they start, beat while live and tick with what they found. Done reads 'Curated in 6.0s'.

items.name: change-review
items.title: ChangeReview
items.description: A governed or irreversible change, reviewed before it runs (Knowledge's commit surface): Now → After, why, 'What this will do' (changes, cautions, what is skipped), Reversible for 24h, and a typed word for destructive changes. Confirming toasts with Undo, logged to the audit trail.

items.name: conflict-pair
items.title: ConflictPair
items.description: Two sources that disagree, side by side, each with trust state, what it says, how it is used and 'Make this the one' (a review action into ChangeReview).

items.name: version-list
items.title: VersionList
items.description: A document's versions (Knowledge's versionList). AiMY's edits are ordinary versions with AiMY as the author and its mark, saying who accepted them. Rows can be picked to read a version; restore with ChangeReview, additively.

items.name: activity
items.title: Activity
items.description: What happened, who did it and when (Sales' activity rows): the subject, the outcome in its tone, then who and when, with the note under it. AiMY's actions say AiMY, never the person's name.

items.name: set-scope-bar
items.title: SetScopeBar
items.description: Bulk work states its scope: N selected, of what, filtered how, the actions that apply, and Clear (the design system's set-scope bar; neither product draws one). The action names the operation and count, never 'Apply'.

items.name: audit-trail
items.title: AuditTrail
items.description: A governed record of changes (design system spec): what changed, who and how, when, and Revert or Irreversible on every entry. AiMY's entries carry its mark. For contact activity use Activity.

items.name: decision-zone
items.title: DecisionZone
items.description: A proposal with operational consequences decided in place (design system spec): the question, its consequence and how long it stays reversible, Accept / Edit / Reject (edit required), Awaiting you, then what was decided and Undo.

items.name: step-list
items.title: StepList
items.description: The compact step list (design system spec): done with what it found ('3 matches · 1.2s'), running, pending with its number, failed. For a long watched run use AgentSteps.

items.name: peek
items.title: Peek
items.description: AiMY's answer in a card that rises out of the float bar (Sales' .b-peek, Knowledge's .aimy-peek): thinks, then answers; three lines then a fade; press to open the canvas; one-click questions under it. The grip folds it into the bar; drag up opens the canvas, down tucks it; a press elsewhere tucks it; × dismisses; Escape tucks. Place it before the Composer in a relative dock.

items.name: memory-panel
items.title: MemoryPanel
items.description: What AiMY carries into this conversation from an earlier thread (Knowledge's memory panel), with Answer without it always present, and each line forgettable with Undo.

items.name: aimy-note
items.title: AimyNote
items.description: A sentence from AiMY on a record or card with where it came from (Sales' .b-aimy): the mark, one useful sentence, the source line, one optional control. Variants quiet, gap, lead.

items.name: briefing
items.title: BriefingActions and Aggregate
items.description: A briefing item's Acknowledge, and Dismiss with one-click reasons in place, each with Undo (doctrine §5.9; design system spec). Aggregate summarises a cluster: stats, rows with share bars, and what the rest add up to.

items.name: usage
items.title: UsageSummary
items.description: How much of AiMY a person has used (Knowledge's usage popover): groups by period, rows 'N of M' with a meter and what it means. Open it from the Composer's usage ring.

items.name: model-picker
items.title: ModelPicker
items.description: Which AiMY model answers (design system spec): the AI dot, the name and tag, and a menu where each model says what it is for.

items.name: autonomy
items.title: Autonomy and AskPolicy
items.description: How much AiMY may do without asking, per kind of work, with the evidence it has earned it: Ask me first / Do it, then tell me / Do it, keep a log. AskPolicy sets Always ask or Just do it per category; governed categories are locked and say why. Every change toasts with Undo; anything irreversible or touching scoring always asks.

items.name: memory-list
items.title: MemoryList
items.description: Everything AiMY remembers about a person or account, with where each came from; forget one in a click with Undo, or all of it after one inline confirm.

items.name: notification-bell
items.title: NotificationBell
items.description: The topbar bell with its micro-interactions: the count slides on and pops (transitions.dev 03); a new ping rocks the bell from its top, three swings in 600ms, and drops one line under it saying what finished, gone after 1.4s (Knowledge's ring and tip). Quiet while its panel is open; still under reduced motion.

items.name: brief
items.title: Brief
items.description: What AiMY has to say at the top of a page, from parts: Brief (wash, accent or plain ground), BriefHead (Sales' large Today title, or the small AiMY label with a work state), BriefLines with BriefLink numbers, BriefFigure (one large figure and its sentence), BriefDeck, BriefActions, BriefStarts (ways to start with counts and reasons), BriefNext (Knowledge's 'Worth asking'). DayBrief is Sales' Today, ready made.

items.name: usage-limit
items.title: UsageLimit
items.description: What a person is told at a usage limit, in the products' words: past your share (You can keep going), limit reached (when it starts again), stopped by an admin (who can turn it back on); always what still works. Pair with the Composer's unavailable sentence and red usage ring.

items.name: stat-tile
items.title: StatTile
items.description: Sales' figure strip: a caption, one figure, and a sub-line that says what it means, divided by a hairline above, never boxed. The change is said in words in the sub-line, never an arrow. A tone recolours the figure. With onClick a tile is a door onto the set it counts (accent sub-line with an arrow). Up to four in a row, reflowing to two then one on the strip's own width.

items.name: description-list
items.title: DescriptionList
items.description: Label and value pairs in the products' two shapes: beside (Sales' record facts, the label in an 8rem column; stacks when narrow) and stacked (Knowledge's facts, a small upper-case label over the value, a note, a hairline between rows, one control on the right). An unknown value says 'Not known' in words. FactGroup is Sales' titled card around a list; FactGroups lays them out.

items.name: timeline
items.title: Timeline
items.description: Sales' history of one record on a rail: a dot per touchpoint in the tone of how it went, a larger accent node where a step was climbed, month headings, an end cap saying where it began. Each row is a disclosure: when, who, how it went, the step reached, how long ago; open, the whole record. Use Activity for a list across many subjects.

items.name: data-table
items.title: DataTable
items.description: Records in columns, in Knowledge's two forms: rows (each row a card, one height, the first column takes its own line below 46rem) and table (a real table, zebra rows, sub-labels, scrolls sideways). Knowledge's three-state sort (up, down, back to the original order) with the arrow always drawn. From the design-system spec: a head that stays put while the body scrolls, and row selection with a select-all box. SortHeader and TableEmpty are exported for sort bars and empty states.

items.name: virtual-list
items.title: VirtualList
items.description: Sales' windowed list for long lists: only the rows near the view exist, about thirty at a time. The row height is measured from a row laid out out of sight, again on resize. Scrolls with the nearest scrolling ancestor or the page. A cursor row is tinted and kept in view. Positioning only; the row's content decides its look.

items.name: kpi-widget
items.title: KpiWidget
items.description: Sales' floor widget: one measure over time against what was promised. Name and verdict word, the figure now, where it began and what was promised, then an 88px line (the recent stretch the figure averages in the accent, a dashed goal with its word), a pointer or arrow-key readout snapping to the nearest point with a value, and AiMY's reading at the foot. KpiWidgets lays them two across.

items.name: target-bar
items.title: TargetBar
items.description: Sales' attainment bar: the figure of its target and the share in words, then one bar with what is in (solid accent), what AiMY expects could still come (hatched), the target crossing the bar and today's pace as a tick inside it. Scale is the target plus a fifth. A key names each band in plain words.

items.name: funnel
items.title: Funnel
items.description: Sales' funnel: a name, a pill bar and a right-aligned count a row. As a funnel every bar is a share of one whole, so the narrowing is the finding; as steps each row carries its own whole. Bars arrive together, never staggered.

items.name: sparkline
items.title: Sparkline
items.description: Knowledge's before-and-after line: the line before a change in the reading ink, after it in the brand, the change a dashed line in the action ink, named underneath.

items.name: trend-chart
items.title: TrendChart
items.description: QA's quality-score trend: ranges (Segmented), Compare (Chip), average/peak/low figures, a smooth accent curve over a fading area, the previous period dashed, a dashed goal with its pill, peak/low/latest written at their points, flagged dips banded in red, and a pointer or arrow-key readout. QA's mis-scaled grid and hand-placed marks are fixed; an empty range says so.

items.name: score-tile
items.title: ScoreTile
items.description: QA's quality-score summary: the score in its tone, how far from the goal, how it moved with a Lucide arrow, and a small curve of the period that is also the button opening the full trend (aria-expanded, aria-controls), with the data's source under it.

items.name: donut
items.title: Donut
items.description: QA's pass/borderline/fail ring: contiguous arcs from twelve o'clock; pointing at a part or its key row (or focusing the row) thickens it with a glow, dims the rest and says it in the centre in its ink. The key gives each part's count and share.

items.name: heatmap
items.title: Heatmap
items.description: QA's goal-by-week grid: a row per goal, a column per period, each cell its score tinted by band, a coaching dot with its note, 'none' where there is no score. Bands are props and the key is drawn from them. Scrolls sideways before it squeezes.

items.name: leaderboard
items.title: Leaderboard
items.description: QA's achievers list: ranked, no bars; a rank badge in medal inks for the first three, the name, and each measure labelled and right-aligned. A row with onOpen is a button.

items.name: app-shell
items.title: AppShell
items.description: The frame every AiMY product sits in: topnav, rail, page. Knowledge's widths on the shell's own width (rail a drawer below 1040, products to a menu below 900); the rail width a setting, 320px by default. useShell gives the rail state. Page and PageHead are Knowledge's page and head.

items.name: topnav
items.title: Topnav
items.description: The bar: Knowledge's markup with Sales' values. Mark, products in a centred pill strip (current in the accent's ink and bolder; not-yet-open ones shown and named), the right-hand controls. Below 1120 the account drops its name, below 1040 a rail toggle appears, below 900 the strip becomes a chevron menu. UserMenu is the account pill and its menu.

items.name: side-nav
items.title: Side navigation
items.description: QA's left navigation between pages, in two forms: open (272px), each page a section with its headline figures and the current page first in an accent card that says You're here; collapsed (64px), icon squares with count badges and tooltips. Remembers the choice; below 1100px of the shell it stays collapsed and opens as a drawer over a scrim. Goes in AppShell's nav slot.

items.name: scroll-dot
items.title: Scroll dot
items.description: QA's scroll indicator, opt-in per scrolling area: a translucent accent dot in place of the native bar that trails a flame sized by scroll speed and lands with a squash when the scroll stops. Drag it to scroll; optionally click the rail to jump, and a Latest pill for threads.

items.name: rail
items.title: Rail
items.description: Sales' left column of standing facts, Knowledge's drawer below 1040 (scrim, Escape, focus in and back). RailDoors/RailDoor are Sales' doors: a standing fact (the diary today, Financials against target, the year left) and the page it opens, each one button. RailLink is the foot row.

items.name: notification-center
items.title: NotificationCenter
items.description: The bell and Sales' panel: Needs you with the unread count and Mark all read; a row per thing with a severity dot beside its type in words, when, one sentence and one action; a question for AiMY at the foot. Read rows keep their ink (hollow dot, 'read'). Empty says so.

items.name: diary
items.title: Diary
items.description: Sales' diary: the month (count, Today, the months either side; a Monday-first grid with up to three dots a day by kind, today marked) and the chosen day beside it (hour or all day, kind in words, who, what, who set the time), add one, and the next three. Arrow keys, Home/End and Page Up/Down move through the days. DiaryLoop is Missing details: meetings nobody wrote up.

items.name: document
items.title: DocPage
items.description: Knowledge's document page: the paper and the details beside it (one column below 1100px of its own width). The bar goes back, says whether changes are saved (SaveState), and hides or shows the details. DocHead holds a DocNotice (archived, replaced, out of date, with the way out), the DocByline (trust state, kind, owner, source with a link to the original, collection, DocVersions) and a note; DocTitle edits in place; VersionPreview says an old version is being read. DocRail holds DocInsights (AiMY noticed), RailBlocks you fold with RailActions, and DocRailFoot (Report a problem inline, Archive or Restore, Delete). DocComments mark and resolve reported problems. DocStart is a blank document's ways to start.

items.name: doc-editor
items.title: DocEditor
items.description: Knowledge's writing tools: SelectionMenu (Bold, Italic, Underline, then what AiMY can do with the selected words), WritingToolbar (add a block, formats, headings, lists, quote, undo, redo, AiMY), BlockMenu ('+' or '/' on an empty line) and AiMenu (AiMY for the whole document), wired together in DocEditor over a contenteditable body. Menus stay on the page, flip above a selection with no room below, close on Escape and move with the arrow keys. AiMY's proposals go to Suggestion, never into the text directly.
